messages.subject: [statnet_help] longitudinal modeling in Statnet
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

The longitudinal modeling capabilities are not yet up and running in the 
publicly avaiable statnet, but getting them there is one of our top 
priorities.  We will be sure to send out a major announcement when it has 
been added.

To all of you who were at Sunbelt, thanks very much for your interest and 
your feedback!

Cheers,
Steve

messages.subject: [statnet_help] clarify license
messages.body_plain:
Dear Statnet developers,

quite confusingly, in the DESCRIPTION file of the statnet package, 
its licence is stated to be GPL 2 or later, but the LICENSE file
contains different things and also the .c sources are messed up to prevent
from taking the source code. Could you please clarify this situation?
Either by making the sources really available and the LICENSE file replaced
or by changing the License line in the DESCRIPTION.

Thanks, best,
Gabor

-- 
Csardi Gabor <csardi@rmki.kfki.hu>    MTA RMKI, ELTE TTK
